notes.markdown:
Live call triggers, custom statuses and a personal blocklist, chat retention with legal hold and export, executives
with assistants, door phones, number porting, caller-ID names, an AI admin copilot and a simpler chat and Messages
screen in MonoPhone.

## New

- **Live call triggers.** Admin, AI, Live call triggers: when a phrase or topic comes up on a live call, alert
  supervisors, post in chat, send a webhook event, add a CRM note, open a helpdesk ticket, tag the call or show a hint
  to the person on the call. Six ready-made triggers in nine languages are enabled with one click, and a tester shows
  what would fire on typed or spoken text. Never stores what was said; needs live assist with a speech provider.
- **Custom status.** Make a status of your own with a text of up to 60 characters, an emoji, a colour (available, away
  or busy) and an automatic end (30 minutes, 1 hour, 4 hours, today or this week). Colleagues see it in Team, in
  presence and in chat headers, and it can carry forwarding rules like any other status. In MonoPhone and the console.
- **Blocklist for calls and SMS.** Block or silence a number, a prefix or withheld numbers, for calls, SMS or both,
  optionally until a set time. A blocked caller hears rejected, busy or not in service; a silenced call goes straight
  to voicemail. Block from Recents or Contacts. Each user's list is their own.
- **Executives and assistants.** Admin, Calls and routing, Executives and assistants: an assistant screens the calls
  of an executive (outside callers only, or every caller), with a private line of numbers that always ring the
  executive. Assistants can set the executive's Do not disturb and forwarding when allowed.
- **Door phones.** Admin, Calls and routing, Door phones: SIP door stations ring people inside, show a still image of
  the camera and open the door with a key press in the call or a relay, also from the Open button in MonoPhone. An
  office-hours schedule decides when they ring.
- **Chat retention, legal hold and export.** Admin, Chat retention: a company retention period with the shortest and
  longest period a chat may set, and whether group owners and admins may set their own. Place a legal hold on a chat or
  a person (nothing is deleted while it lasts) and export a chat as PDF, JSON or ZIP with its attachments. Members see
  the period in force and any hold in the console and in MonoPhone.
- **Number porting.** Admin, Calls and routing, DIDs, Number porting: keep a port request in one place (numbers,
  account at the old carrier, the signed letter of authorisation, dates and carrier answers) with reminders. On the
  confirmed date the numbers join the chosen trunk by themselves.
- **Caller-ID names.** Admin, Calls and routing, DIDs, Caller names: the name each of your numbers shows on outgoing
  calls, and names for incoming outside callers looked up in the directory, company contacts and other sources.
- **Recording policies and card-payment pause.** Admin, Recording: policies per company, site, extension, user, queue,
  number or trunk, with never, on demand and a percentage of calls. Pausing for a card payment can also hide the keys
  pressed while the recording is paused.
- **Storage compliance.** Admin, Backups, Storage status: one page for the backup state, extra backup copies on other
  storage destinations with their own schedule and retention, write-once storage and legal hold, signed manifests that
  prove a backup is unchanged, and alerts when a backup fails or is late. Also in MonoPhone's admin status.
- **AI admin copilot.** AI, Admin copilot in the console, and Settings, Admin, Copilot in MonoPhone: configure and
  troubleshoot the PBX in plain language. It looks things up with your permissions, shows every change as a preview
  before you apply it, logs it in the audit log and undoes a whole change set in one step. Uses your company's own AI
  model.
- **PBX updates in MonoPhone.** Settings, Admin, PBX updates: the installed version, Check for updates, the What's new
  notes of every newer version, and Install update with progress, for administrators with the matching permission.
- **Rich chat notifications.** Chat notifications on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Android show the sender's name and photo
  and are grouped per chat. Notifications never carry the message text through the push service.
- **Better browser notifications.** Answer or decline a ringing call and reply to a chat message from the browser
  notification; one counted notification per chat and per SMS conversation; the sender's initials as the icon; admin
  alerts named by kind that open the right page. On iPhone and iPad, Safari shows how to add the web phone to the Home
  Screen.
- **Hours for one date.** Office-hours schedules can have different hours for a single date. In MonoPhone, changing
  Today's hours applies to today only by default.
- **Password reset by e-mail.** Admin, Users: Send password reset mails a single-use link valid for one day. Also in
  MonoPhone's admin user page.

## Improved

- **One kind of chat.** A chat is now a direct message or a group. A group has two plain settings: Who can post
  (everyone or only admins) and Who can join (invited people only, anyone can ask to join, or anyone in the company).
  New groups take a name, photo and description. One list with All, Unread, Groups and Direct filters, and error
  messages that say what went wrong where it happened.
- **New Messages screen in MonoPhone.** A lean header with only New and a menu, one search field, one row of small
  filters, Archived chats folded into one row at the top, Mark all as read, and a clear reason when team chat is not
  available.
- **Admin and Supervisor menus in MonoPhone.** Both sections now open a side menu from the menu button or an edge
  swipe, with grouped entries, badges for counts and Back to MonoPhone at the bottom. Tablets show the Supervisor menu
  as a side list.
- **Contact and call details in MonoPhone.** Actions are shown as tiles that wrap instead of being cut, list rows keep
  only the Call button and open the details on tap, colleague and contact details list recent calls with that person,
  and About shows the version with Check for updates on one tile. MonoPhone also works better with older PBX versions.
- **Finish setup box.** While setup steps remain, a box at the top of the admin home shows how many are left and
  continues with the next one. It can be collapsed, or hidden for the whole company.
- **Call flow editor.** A palette of components grouped by kind sits next to the canvas. Remove a node with its ×, the
  Delete key or Delete node (with a confirmation when it has connections, and undo), and a click on a node opens its
  properties.
- **Call pull is clearer.** Dialling `*85` when there is no call to pull now says "No call to pull" instead of
  reporting an unknown feature code, and MonoPhone shows the pull button only when one of your calls can be pulled.
- **Integrations page.** Admin, Integrations shows a searchable list next to the details of the selected integration:
  what it does, the data it reads and writes, its permissions and settings. The install form puts required fields
  first and masks stored secrets.
- **Single sign-on.** While single sign-on is required, accounts without a system role are given no password, and the
  sign-in pages say so. Accounts created on first sign-in get an extension from a range you choose, SAML group claims
  can also set the department, and identity providers with ECDSA keys are supported.
- **Sites.** A new phone joins its user's site, or the site whose network it is provisioned from. A site you choose by
  hand is kept.
- **Web phone ringing and closing.** Outgoing calls in the web phone play a ringback tone until answered (or the
  network's own tones), the ring volume can be set, and an × closes the phone. During a call it asks whether to keep
  the call in the background or hang up, and never hangs up by itself.
- **MonoPhone polish.** Opening the Admin section asks only for your passkey when you have one, with no separate
  password. Chat and SMS headers show the other person's photo or the group picture, Team shows a colleague's custom
  status emoji on their photo, and keypad tones moved to Advanced settings.
- **BI feed ready out of the box.** Admin, BI feed: the feed is set up by the installer and the updater, so you only
  create a BI user; no server settings to edit.
- **Toll-fraud limits per calling profile.** Calling profiles can set their own limit on simultaneous international
  calls and calls per hour at night.
- **Dialer campaigns.** A compliance page per campaign shows calling-window checks and the abandoned-call rate;
  contacts can be edited and imported from a file, and opt-outs imported from CSV.
- **API changes.** On chat message tasks the field `external_key` is now `external_ref`. Chat lists (mentions,
  starred messages, threads, the Shared tab, reactions, scheduled messages, reminders) are paged with `cursor` and
  `next_cursor`; the `before` and `before_seq` parameters were removed. Following threads, starring, chat settings,
  company chat controls, poll votes, scheduled messages and reminders now require `If-Match` when changed, and their
  answers carry a `version`. Update scripts and integrations that use these.

## Fixed

- SIP trace now captures calls made from MonoPhone and the web phone on installs where the console and the call
  engine run on separate servers; such traces showed no calls before.
- Install update in Admin, Updates showed the previous update as already installed and stopped; it now shows the
  progress of the new one at once.
- MonoPhone: Make default now switches the line, the keypad and outgoing calls to that account at once and is
  remembered at the next start. It is shown only when the phone has more than one account.
- Backups failed on installs updated to the version with sites; they run again.
- Profile photos uploaded from MonoPhone showed as broken images in the console.
- MonoPhone: call recordings and voicemail in the Admin and Supervisor sections now play on iPhone and Android, from
  the loudspeaker, and an error says exactly why a file cannot be played.
- MonoPhone: a phone set up with a setup code no longer asks for a password sign-in.

## Security

- Security fixes (low): sign-in and account protection, and data separation between companies.
